test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following statements is correct about a computer?

options.text: A computer is composed of only hardware.
An electronic device that stores, retrieves and processes data.
A computer can organise all information on its own.
A computer is composed of only software.

solution:
The correct answer is __**An electronic device that stores, retrieves and processes data.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• A computer is a machine that can store and process information.
 
• Most computers rely on a binary system, which uses two variables, 0 and 1, to complete tasks such as storing data, calculating algorithms, and displaying information.
 
• A computer is composed of hardware and software.
 
• Users add information to the computer.
 
• **An electronic device that stores, retrieves, and processes data.**
 
• **Hence Option 2 is correct.**
